description: Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka - Notice of Amendment that Rules under Regulation of Insurance Industry Act
categorisation: This gazette content contains rules made by the Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000, specifically amending previous rules and forms related to insurance industry regulations. This constitutes legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for the insurance industry, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
